about: FR-11 interior parity references (BB1, BB6, BB7, BB8), generated by scripts/parity/gen_r_bb.R - do not edit by hand. Floats are %.17g decimal strings of IEEE-754 doubles; null = not recorded.

definitions.h1: BiCopHfunc1 = P(U2 <= v | U1 = u) = dC/du
definitions.h2: BiCopHfunc2 = P(U1 <= u | U2 = v) = dC/dv
definitions.hinv1: BiCopHinv1: the y with h1(u, y) = v (inverse in the second argument)
definitions.hinv2: BiCopHinv2: the x with h2(x, v) = u (inverse in the first argument)
definitions.pars: reference-agnostic key (README): [theta, delta] of the unrotated family (Joe 1997, ch. 5), positive for every rotation; native = the VineCopula call (codes 7-10, +10 for 180, +20 for 90, +30 for 270; both parameters negated for 90/270, measured)

convention_checks.judged_on: median over the points (max recorded); param_* absolute against the textbook CDF; pdf errors relative above pdf = 1, absolute below
